newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Banque Nationale de Paris registered in NZ as bank.
newsitem.headline: Banque Nationale de Paris registered in NZ as bank.

text.p: Banque Nationale de Paris was authorised on Friday to operate as a bank in New Zealand, Reserve Bank Governor Don Brash said.
The French bank will operate a branch in Auckland and brings the total number of banks registered in New Zealand to 18.
BNP has appointed Michael Sanders as General Manager for New Zealand.
The bank is one the world's largest with assets of around NZ$500 billion.
Sanders said it sees the opening of a branch in New Zealand as a natural extention of branches it already operates in Australasia.
"The establishment of this branch reflects the growing importance and commitment that the BNP places on the economies of the region," BNP said.
BNP New Zealand will focus on providing a competitive spectrum of domestic and offshore wholesale banking services to the public and coroporate sectors.
